description: Fix all 6 issues in index.html: broken script tags preventing mobile load, VRF code style, logo not appearing, overlay background color, mini map (caused by script tags), and address spacing
steps: Fix script tags on lines 13-15 of /projects/sandbox/timestamp/index.html: change `<\/script>` to `</script>` for all three CDN script tags (leaflet, piexif, qrcode). This is the root cause of 'unable to open' on mobile since GAS HtmlService does not need escaped closing script tags.
Modify the generateVRF() function (around line 583) to produce a longer alphanumeric code (12+ characters) in format like 'VRF-A3X7K9M2P4B6' instead of the current 6-character code.

In the renderOverlay() function (around line 1095), change the VRF code rendering from horizontal text on the bottom-right to a vertically-rotated text (using ctx.save/rotate/restore with -90 degree rotation) positioned on the right edge of the overlay, with a smaller font size.

In the renderOverlay() function, remove the tier check for logo drawing. Change `if (state.logoImage && state.tier !== 'free')` to just `if (state.logoImage)` so the logo always appears when uploaded regardless of subscription tier.
In the renderOverlay() function, change the overlay background from `ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.65)'` to `ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,0.75)'` for a transparent white background.

Update text colors in renderOverlay() to work with the white background: keep the gold color (#D4A841) for line 1 (date/time/location), change white (#FFFFFF) text on lines 2-5 to dark color (#333333 or similar) since the background is now white.
Reduce line spacing in renderOverlay(): change `lineHeight = fontSize * 1.5` to `lineHeight = fontSize * 1.25` to make address and other text lines more compact/closer to the bottom.
acceptance_criteria: All three script tags on lines 13-15 use normal `</script>` closing tags without backslash escaping
generateVRF() produces codes with 12+ alphanumeric characters after the 'VRF-' prefix
VRF code is rendered vertically (rotated -90 degrees) on the right side of the overlay in a small font
Logo is drawn in the overlay whenever state.logoImage exists, regardless of tier
Overlay background uses rgba(255,255,255,0.75) or similar white transparency
Text colors on the overlay are adjusted to be readable on white background (dark text for info lines)
Line height is reduced to fontSize * 1.25 for more compact spacing
verification: Open /projects/sandbox/timestamp/index.html in a browser and verify no JavaScript console errors (script tags load correctly)
Inspect the source to confirm no `<\/script>` patterns remain
Verify the renderOverlay function uses white background, dark text, vertical VRF, no tier check on logo, and reduced line height
findings: All 7 changes applied successfully to index.html. No build/test system exists - verification is manual browser testing only. Script tags fixed (no more backslash escaping), VRF generates 12-char codes, overlay uses white background with dark text, line height reduced, logo always renders, VRF code displayed vertically on right edge.
